name: Monaco Grand Prix
sources_2026_10_03: Formula1.com race report and results (2026-06-07), FIA race report (2026-06-07), Haas F1 race recap (2026-06-07), Sky Sports (2026-06-07), Crash.net (2026-06-12), Formula1.com/FIA appeal coverage (2026-09-04).
summary: Kimi Antonelli led from pole to win by 6.271s over Lewis Hamilton for his fifth straight victory. Max Verstappen lost power at the start and retired, while late crashes by Lance Stroll and Charles Leclerc brought a Safety Car and red flag after the resurfaced final corner broke up; the restart created an eight-lap finish. Carlos Sainz then retired after restart collisions, making seven retirements, while George Russell fell to P12 after a pit-lane speeding penalty became a drive-through. Gasly finished third on the road, but his two penalties were initially overturned and then reinstated on appeal, leaving Hadjar third and Gasly seventh in the final classification.
